title: Unify touch targets, focus-visible gestures, and VPAT evidence for compact control clusters
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Audit and remediate inconsistent touch target sizes, focus-visible styles, and gesture interactions across compact control clusters (chip groups, compact toolbars, chart annotation controls). Produce a VPAT evidence package that covers touch, keyboard, and contrast scenarios across light/dark/high-contrast themes and document design tokens and dev guidance for long-term conformance.
background: Recent customer reports and QA logs show failures on mobile/tablet for small density controls: hit area misses, invisible focus on custom gesture interactions, and tooltip/long-press conflicts that prevent keyboard parity. Our VPAT submission requires explicit evidence that compact controls meet WCAG 2.2 + mobile interaction guidance and that dynamic theming preserves contrast ratios for actionable controls.
acceptance_criteria: All compact control families (chip-set, compact buttons, table row actions, chart annotation toggles) meet a minimum 44x44 dp or accessible equivalent with programmatic adjustments documented.
Focus-visible indicator is present, meets contrast for all themes, and is consistent across keyboard and touch-exposed focus (when focusable via external keyboard or accessibility switch).
Long-press tooltips and gesture-based menus do not break keyboard-only flows; keyboard shortcuts or explicit toggle alternatives are available and documented.
VPAT evidence artifacts exported (screenshots, test scripts, conformance matrix) and uploaded to the VPAT folder with corresponding test IDs.
Design tokens updated with clear migration guidance and a runtime checklist for developers to validate touch/contrast during reviews.
tasks: Inventory all compact control components and export current token usages (contrast, spacing, hit area) - owner: design
Create prototyped touch target guidelines for 44dp/48dp fallback with tokenized CSS variables - owner: design
Partner with components eng to add focus-visible utilities and a11y hooks (aria-describedby for long-press tooltips) - owner: engineering
Add automated visual contrast checks for focus rings in CI and a small e2e suite for touch hit test on mobile emulators - owner: qa
Draft VPAT evidence package with mapping to WCAG success criteria and record video walkthroughs (mobile + keyboard) - owner: design
Run internal UX review with Solutions and Support for edge cases (screen readers + switch control) and collect sign-offs - owner: product

qa_plan: Automated visual regression with focus-state snapshots for light/dark/high-contrast; mobile emulator hit-testing script that asserts 90% success rate for target taps in CI. Manual verification matrix for screen reader flow and switch control on iOS/Android. List of test devices and OS versions in the VPAT folder.
risk: Tight space constraints in existing compact navs may require layout trade-offs or enabling an optional 'expanded touch mode' which changes visual density; this could affect pixel-perfect UIs and require product review.
rollout_plan: Canary deploy component library change behind feature flag for internal apps, collect telemetry for missed taps and focus events for 2 weeks, then enable default once hit rates improve and VPAT package is finalized. Communicate token changes with migration guide and codemods.
